It follows immediately from Chow's lemma that we can refine a
standard ph covering by a standard ph covering corresponding to
a surjective projective morphism.

Let <MATH_0001> be a standard ph covering.
Let <MATH_0002> be a morphism of affine schemes.
Then <MATH_0003> is a
standard ph covering.

Let <MATH_0001> be proper surjective and let an affine open covering
<MATH_0002> be given as in
Definition <REF_0001>.
Then <MATH_0003> is proper surjective
(Morphisms, Lemmas <REF_0002> and
<REF_0003>).
Also, <MATH_0004>
is an affine open covering.
This concludes the proof.

of maps with target <MATH_0002> has a refinement by a standard ph covering:
